title: QUIZ - 83
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Interpreting a Constant Rate of Change
questions.learningObjective: Interpret what a constant rate of change means for a one-unit change in input
questions.question: A linear model shows that a delivery truck's fuel level decreases at a constant rate of 7 liters per hours driven. After 1 additional hours drive, by how much does the quantity change?
questions.explanation: A constant rate of change of 7 liters per hours drive means the quantity decreases by exactly 7 liters for each additional hours drive.
questions.hint: A constant rate of change applies the same amount of change for every one-unit increase in the input.

questions.concept: Comparing Rates of Change
questions.learningObjective: Compare the rates of change of two linear quantities
questions.question: Tank A's quantity changes at a rate of 11 units per hour, and Company A's changes at a rate of 8 units per hour. Which changes faster?

options.label: D
options.text: They change at the same rate

questions.explanation: The rate of change measures how quickly the quantity changes per unit time. Since 11 > 8, Tank A changes faster.
questions.hint: Compare the numerical rates of change directly; a larger rate means faster change.
